title: MCP response enrichment pattern — match Knowns depth
content: WM tool responses should match Knowns response depth for AI agent compatibility. Key enrichments: wm_doc.list returns tags/description/timestamps per doc, wm_task.board returns full task detail (ACs, timestamps, priority, timeSpent) per task, wm_memory.list returns content/camelCase dates. Response format uses camelCase JSON (createdAt, updatedAt) matching Knowns convention.
